title: In Time
style: raw blues, guitar, stripped-down, male vocals, raw, blues
lyrics:
[Verse]
In the quiet
In the light
In the night
In the shade
Time is slippin' away
All the moments we could save
We could taste
We could make
Time is slippin' away

[Pre-Chorus]
When you tell me you don't know
Do you mean it?
Do you mean it?
When you tell me you don't know
Do you mean it?
Do you mean it?

[Chorus]
Oh
I wish that all of your wishes come true
For you
All the time
Time is now
Time is now
[Verse 2]
Where is here? Where is there? Where's a wish? Where's a prayer?
Time is slippin' away
What's a song? What's a song? It's a thought all along
Time is slippin' away

[Pre-Chorus]
When you tell me you don't know
Do you mean it?
Do you mean it?
When you tell me you don't know
Do you mean it?
Do you mean it?

[Chorus]
Oh
I wish that all of your wishes come true
For you
All the time
Time is now
Time is now
[Bridge]
And sing it to me
Sing it back to me
It's a song
It's a song
Sing it back to me
It's a song
It's a song
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
It's a song
It's a song
[Outro]
Time is now
Time is now
Time is now
Time is now
